kait: Heads-up: planning a short maintenance tonight 00:45-01:15 UTC on the compute-thermal pool (racks t1-t4). Goal: address thermal margin regression after recent driver bump; rolling soft reboots + nvlink sanity check.

mike: Which racks are canaries? Any tenants excluded?

kait: Canary on t1 (single rack). No reserved/dedicated tenants in that pool. Affects shared and interruptible. Expect per-rack drain ~8-12m. Overall window 30m including checks.

sanjay: Network note: eu-us peering has constrained bandwidth tonight, so prefer local standby for backfill. If we must cross-region, throttle to 5%/min and track egress.

elaine: Ops plan: cordon+drain each rack, kv cache preseed, run nvlink test, then restore. Scripts: `./infra cordon --pool compute-thermal --racks t1` then `./infra drain --grace 300 --pool compute-thermal --racks t1` then `./infra kv-seed --pool compute-thermal --racks t1 --timeout 600` then `./infra nvlink-check --rack t1`.

mike: Pager thresholds? I can watch dashboards.

kait: Pager: P95 latency > 220ms for >5m OR sustained task evictions >0.6% for 10m. Rollback if P99 errors >1% across canary or packet drops >0.3%.

sanjay: Cost note: using local standby adds ~7 GPU-hours (~$1.2k). Cross-region egress would be extra; flagged to finance.
